Agent Name: Behavioral_Expert  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Behavioral_Expert made an error in concluding that all residents are humans based on the consistent statement "At least one of us is a human." The mistake lies in the incorrect analysis of the scenario where some residents could be vampires. If there is at least one human, a vampire could still truthfully say, "At least one of us is a human," by lying about the presence of any vampires. Thus, the possibility of some residents being vampires was prematurely dismissed.
